# Loom & Co.

> Handwoven bedsheets, comforters and cushions from artisan looms in India. Considered, unfussy, and made to be used rather than saved for guests.

Loom & Co. is an online-only home textiles brand. Every product is woven on traditional handlooms by artisan weavers in India — no power looms.

## Site

- [Home](https://loomandco.com/): brand overview, trending products, shop-by-category
- [Shop](https://loomandco.com/shop): the full catalogue — Bedsheets, Cushions, Comforters
- [About Us](https://loomandco.com/about): the handloom story
- [FAQs](https://loomandco.com/faqs): sizing, colour, care, shipping
